items.source: Metadata resolution strategy can be pluggable. A good default is ClassNameBeanWiringInfoResolver, which uses the fully-qualified class name as bean name.
items.translation: 元数据解析策略可以是可插拔的。一个良好的默认选项是 ClassNameBeanWiringInfoResolver，它使用完全限定类名作为 Bean 名称。

items.source: Resolve the BeanWiringInfo for the given bean instance.
items.translation: 解析给定 Bean 实例的 BeanWiringInfo。

items.source: beanInstance - the bean instance to resolve info for
items.translation: beanInstance - 要解析信息的 Bean 实例

items.source: the BeanWiringInfo, or null if not found
